sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 1313 of 2022 dated 22.06.2022, S.C. No. 1809 of 2022, instituted under Sections 498A, 323, 379, 406, 463, 504,
506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, in which cognizance has been taken only under Sectino 498(A) of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. The petitioner is the husband of the opposite party no. 2.
4.
It has been jointly prayed that the matter be referred Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57635 of 2023(3) dt.09-11-2023 for mediation as there is every chance of amicable settlement between the parties.
5. In such view of the matter, the matter is referred for mediation.
